# Core model and vocabularies

Input documents are JSON. Decimal values are strings (`"1250.00"`); floats are rejected. Unknown fields are errors.

Root documents: [Engagement](#engagement), [Scenario](#scenario), [CostPolicy](#costpolicy), [TolerancePolicy](#tolerancepolicy).

## Classes

### Engagement

An evaluated client-provider relationship: parties, services, effective-dated arrangement versions, and an optional delivery plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | one of `0.2` | yes |  |  |
| `engagement_id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `name` | string | no |  |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |  |
| `start_date` | date | yes |  |  |
| `end_date` | date | yes |  |  |
| `packs` | list of [PackRef](#packref) | no |  |  |
| `money_policy` | [MoneyPolicy](#moneypolicy) | no |  |  |
| `parties` | list of [Party](#party) | no |  |  |
| `unit_definitions` | list of [UnitDefinition](#unitdefinition) | yes (at least 1) |  |  |
| `weight_tables` | list of [ComplexityWeightTable](#complexityweighttable) | no |  |  |
| `services` | list of [Service](#service) | yes (at least 1) |  |  |
| `arrangement_versions` | list of [ArrangementVersion](#arrangementversion) | yes (at least 1) |  |  |
| `delivery_plan` | [DeliveryPlan](#deliveryplan) | no |  |  |
| `risk_allocations` | list of [RiskAllocation](#riskallocation) | no |  |  |
| `descriptors` | object (map) | no |  |  |
| `client_value_unit` | string | no |  | Scenario quantity used for effective client unit price: a name, "weighted:<name>[:<table>]", or names joined with + to sum commensurable units ("docs_a+docs_b"). Required when more than one unit type is priced. |

### Scenario

A time-indexed set of assumptions that one or more arrangements are evaluated against.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `horizon` | [Horizon](#horizon) | no |  |  |
| `assumptions` | list of [Assumption](#assumption) | no |  |  |
| `derived` | list of [DerivedQuantity](#derivedquantity) | no |  | Quantities computed each month from assumptions, e.g. counting rules; usable anywhere a quantity_source is |
| `breach_mode` | [BreachMode](#breachmode) | no |  |  |
| `termination_date` | date | no |  | Run the engagement as terminated on this date (inclusive): fees and costs stop, minimums follow each commitment's termination_rule, the version's termination_fee is charged, allowances expire, and unamortized one-time costs are written off. |
| `probability_label` | string | no |  |  |
| `deviation_driver` | string | no |  |  |

### Assumption

A scenario quantity. `value` is the TOTAL for `time_period`, not a per-month rate.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | Referenced by components as quantity_source ("scenario.<name>" or "<name>"); role or band quantities use <name>.<role> or <name>.<band> |
| `value` | decimal (string) | yes |  | Total for time_period, as a decimal string |
| `unit` | string | yes |  |  |
| `time_period` | string | yes |  | YYYY-MM, YYYY, YYYY-MM..YYYY-MM, or TERM |
| `origin` | [Origin](#origin) | yes |  |  |
| `basis` | [AssumptionBasis](#assumptionbasis) | no | `TOTAL` | TOTAL (default): value is the total for time_period, spread across its months. RATE: value applies to every month unchanged (use for rates and shares such as a re-issue rate). |
| `distribution` | [Distribution](#distribution) | no | `FLAT` |  |
| `profile` | list of decimal (string) | no |  |  |

### Adjustment

A mechanism that modifies a named subtotal at a declared evaluation step: discount, rebate, collar, service credit, holdback, bonus, cap, or indexation.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `type` | [AdjustmentType](#adjustmenttype) | yes |  |  |
| `applies_to` | list of → [FeeComponent](#feecomponent) (by id) | no |  |  |
| `percent` | decimal (string) | no |  |  |
| `amount` | decimal (string) | no |  |  |
| `cap_percent` | decimal (string) | no |  |  |
| `trigger` | string | no |  | Scenario quantity that triggers SLA_CREDIT, BONUS, or HOLDBACK in a month |
| `threshold` | decimal (string) | no |  | DISCOUNT or REBATE only: subtotal over the accumulation period at which the percentage starts to apply |
| `threshold_scope` | [ThresholdScope](#thresholdscope) | no |  | Required with a threshold. EXCESS_ONLY: the percentage applies to the amount above the threshold ("10% off charges above the minimum"). ENTIRE_SUBTOTAL: once the threshold is reached, it applies to the whole period subtotal. |
| `accumulation_period` | [AccumulationPeriod](#accumulationperiod) | no |  | Required for CAP, REBATE, and threshold DISCOUNT; no default |
| `component_id` | → [FeeComponent](#feecomponent) (by id) | no |  |  |
| `lower` | decimal (string) | no |  |  |
| `upper` | decimal (string) | no |  |  |
| `outside_rate_schedule_id` | → [RateSchedule](#rateschedule) (by id) | no |  |  |

## Core vocabularies

### AccumulationPeriod

The period over which an allowance, minimum, tier counter, or capacity limit accumulates: MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR, CONTRACT_YEAR, TERM.

`MONTH`, `QUARTER`, `YEAR`, `CONTRACT_YEAR`, `TERM`

### AdjustmentType

`DISCOUNT`, `REBATE`, `COLLAR`, `SLA_CREDIT`, `HOLDBACK`, `BONUS`, `CAP`, `INDEXATION`

### AggregationScope

`COMPONENT`, `SERVICE`, `ENGAGEMENT`

### AssumptionBasis

`TOTAL`, `RATE`

### Avoidability

`AVOIDABLE`, `UNAVOIDABLE`, `UNKNOWN`

### BillingBasis

`TIME`, `RESOURCE`, `CAPACITY`, `OUTPUT`, `USAGE`, `FIXED`, `COST`, `OUTCOME`

### BreachMode

`OVERFLOW_COST`, `BACKLOG`, `INFEASIBLE`

### CalculationMethod

`FIXED_RECURRING`, `TIME`, `DEDICATED_RESOURCE`, `UNIT_OUTPUT`, `WEIGHTED_UNIT_OUTPUT`, `ALLOWANCE_OVERAGE`, `FIXED_PROJECT`, `COST_PLUS`, `OUTCOME_ADJUSTMENT`

### ChargeCadence

`ONE_TIME`, `MONTHLY`, `QUARTERLY`, `ANNUAL`, `EVENT`, `USAGE_TRIGGERED`

### ClassificationAuthority

`PROVIDER`, `CLIENT`, `JOINT`

### CommitmentKind

`MINIMUM_SPEND`, `MINIMUM_VOLUME`, `RESERVED_CAPACITY`, `PREPAID_CREDIT`

### CostBehavior

`FIXED`, `VARIABLE`, `STEP`, `TIERED_VARIABLE`, `ONE_TIME`

### CostCategory

`DEDICATED_LABOR`, `POOLED_LABOR`, `DELIVERY_MANAGEMENT`, `QA_REWORK`, `AI_INFERENCE`, `PLATFORM_OPERATIONS`, `THIRD_PARTY`, `CLIENT_IMPLEMENTATION`, `REUSABLE_ENGINEERING`, `TRANSITION`, `ENGAGEMENT_OVERHEAD`, `IDLE_POOLED_CAPACITY`, `CORPORATE_OVERHEAD`

### CostPeriod

`MONTHLY`, `ANNUAL`, `TERM`

### DerivedRounding

`NONE`, `HALF_UP`, `DOWN`, `UP`

### Distribution

`FLAT`, `PROFILE`

### EvidenceClass

A_DIRECT, B_CORROBORATED, C_INFERENCE, D_PROPOSED. Independent of prevalence.

`A_DIRECT`, `B_CORROBORATED`, `C_INFERENCE`, `D_PROPOSED`

### MarginLayer

DIRECT_DELIVERY, ENGAGEMENT_AVOIDABLE, PORTFOLIO_SHARED, CORPORATE_OVERHEAD. A cost policy maps every cost category to exactly one layer.

`DIRECT_DELIVERY`, `ENGAGEMENT_AVOIDABLE`, `PORTFOLIO_SHARED`, `CORPORATE_OVERHEAD`

### Origin

Every assumption is OBSERVED, CONTRACTED, ESTIMATED, ILLUSTRATIVE, or INTERNAL_POLICY.

`OBSERVED`, `CONTRACTED`, `ESTIMATED`, `ILLUSTRATIVE`, `INTERNAL_POLICY`

### OutcomeDirection

`HIGHER_IS_BETTER`, `LOWER_IS_BETTER`

### OutcomeForm

`SHARE`, `SUCCESS`, `PERCENT_OF_OUTCOME`

### PartyRole

`CLIENT`, `PROVIDER`, `SUBCONTRACTOR`

### Prevalence

`ESTABLISHED_COMMON`, `DOCUMENTED_SPECIALIZED`, `EMERGING`, `UNVERIFIED`

### ProrationPolicy

`CALENDAR_DAYS`, `FULL_MONTH_FROM_NEXT`, `FULL_MONTH_FROM_CURRENT`

### Recognition

When an accumulated effect is charged: CUMULATIVE (the month the threshold is crossed), PERIOD_END (true-up in the final month), PER_SEGMENT (monthly only).

`CUMULATIVE`, `PERIOD_END`, `PER_SEGMENT`

### RiskBearer

`CLIENT`, `PROVIDER`, `SHARED`, `THIRD_PARTY`, `NONE_ADVERSE`

### RolloverPolicy

`NONE`, `NEXT_PERIOD`, `TERM`

### RoundingLevel

`LINE_ITEM`, `PERIOD_TOTAL`

### RoundingMode

`HALF_UP`, `HALF_EVEN`

### Severity

`INFO`, `WARNING`, `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `ERROR`

### ShortfallRule
